XData.name: DTL
XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.EDI.XML.Document' sourceDocType='AdtAmWellHl7:AmWellAdt' targetDocType='PatientServiceUpdatePatientRequest:initiatePatientService' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for AmWell Hl7 Adt to Initiate patient service for Guarantors </annotation> <assign value='"100:AMWELL"' property='target.{application}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorNumber(1).ID}' property='target.{patient.sourceMrns(1).mrn}' action='set' /> <assign value='"528125086"' property='target.{patient.sourceMrns(1).assigningAuthority}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.guarSex' property='target.{patient.genderType}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorDateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' property='target.{patient.dateOfBirth}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorSSN}' property='target.{patient.ssn}' action='set' />
<assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress})' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).line1}' action='set' /> <assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).otherdesignation})' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).line2}' action='set' /> <assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).city})' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).stateorprovince})' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).state}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).zip}' action='set' /> <assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).country})' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).country}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).countyparishcode}' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).state}' action='set' /> <assign value='"HOMEADDR"' property='target.{patient.addresses(1).type}' action='set' />
<assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorPhNumHome(1).phonenumber1}' property='srcPhNumber' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(srcPhNumber) > 9' > <true> <assign value='$extract(srcPhNumber,4,10)' property='target.{patient.phones(1).phoneNumber}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(srcPhNumber,1,3)' property='target.{patient.phones(1).areaCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='"HOMEPHONE"' property='target.{patient.phones(1).phoneType}' action='set' /> </true> </if>
<assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorPhNumHome(1).Emailaddress}' property='target.{patient.emails(1).address}' action='set' />
<assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorName(1).familyname.surname})' property='target.{patient.names(1).familyName}' action='set' /> <assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorName(1).givenname})' property='target.{patient.names(1).givenName}' action='set' /> <assign value='..ToUpper(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorName(1).secondandfurthergivennamesor})' property='target.{patient.names(1).middleName}' action='set' /> <assign value='"HOMEEMAIL"' property='target.{patient.emails(1).type}' action='set' /> <if condition='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent} = "A23"' > <true> <assign value='"A08"' property='target.{transactionType}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' property='target.{transactionType}' action='set' /> </false> </if>
<assign value='"528125086"' property='target.{transactionFacility}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{MSH:DateTimeOfMessage.timeofanevent}' property='target.{transactionTime}' action='set' /> </transform>
